draft.reply_body:
Hi Teemu,

Thank you for flagging this, and sorry for the confusion. Elina confirmed in writing on 14 September that you had a 3-day extension on your rental at no extra charge, and since you returned the equipment within that extended period, that charge shouldn't have gone through.

We've corrected the invoice and removed the extra-days charge. You won't be billed for the extension period, exactly as agreed.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks for pointing it out.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy
